capabilities.description: Use when the user asks what happened this week on X, wants the week pulled together, or when the weekly recap routine runs.

capabilities.name: Read a thread or post
capabilities.description: Use when the user pastes a post, thread, or profile link and wants it read, summarized, or checked.

capabilities.name: Draft a post or reply
capabilities.description: Use when the user asks for a post, a reply, or a thread built on something from the brief or a link they pasted.

capabilities.name: Daily X brief
capabilities.description: Once a day at the hour you pick, reads your watch list and sends the day's items grouped by theme with a link on every line.

capabilities.name: Weekly X recap
capabilities.description: Every Friday, pulls the week's briefs into the themes that held, the voices worth adding, the accounts that went quiet, and what to read this weekend.

summary.en: Monitors your competitors' public websites, ads, marketing, pricing, and positioning on a standing cadence. Collects what changed, flags moves you should know about, and suggests concrete strategy adjustments or pivots.
summary.zh: Monitors your competitors' public websites, ads, marketing, pricing, and positioning on a standing cadence. Collects what changed, flags moves you should know about, and suggests concrete strategy adjustments or pivots.

description.en: Monitors your competitors' public websites, ads, marketing, pricing, and positioning on a standing cadence. Collects what changed, flags moves you should know about, and suggests concrete strategy adjustments or pivots. Never posts or contacts anyone.
description.zh: Monitors your competitors' public websites, ads, marketing, pricing, and positioning on a standing cadence. Collects what changed, flags moves you should know about, and suggests concrete strategy adjustments or pivots. Never posts or contacts anyone.

capabilities.name: market-researcher-setup
capabilities.description: Use this when the bot is first imported, when the user wants to change company, competitors, surfaces, cadence, or destination, or when their own positioning, pricing, or offers change. Four beats ending in first proof: a messaging matrix and a swipe file of a competitor's live ads. Also holds the our-marketing baseline.

capabilities.name: connect-accounts
capabilities.description: Use this when a platform account is needed and not yet signed in, when a session has expired, or when the user adds a platform. Runs the platform widget, the sign-in handoff in the bot's own browser, the verification screenshot, the ACCOUNTS entry, and the export fallback.

capabilities.name: ad-and-creative-analysis
capabilities.description: Use this when you need to know what a competitor is advertising and how their creative is working: hooks, offers, CTAs, formats, fatigue from run dates, the channel mix across networks, and the swipe file of ad screenshots organized by theme.

capabilities.name: landing-page-and-offer-watch
capabilities.description: Use this when you need a competitor's page and offer broken down or compared with the user's own: fold message, offer, CTA, form fields, proof, objections, plus price movement and the dated promotion calendar.

capabilities.name: search-overlap
capabilities.description: Use this when you need to know who shares the results with the user on their core terms. Public paid and organic SERP checks, title and meta movement, brand-term defense, and the Search Console consequence when it is signed in.

capabilities.name: messaging-matrix
capabilities.description: Use this when the user asks how they compare, for research on their own product, for a homepage screenshot, or for the first step a marketer takes when planning a campaign. Their claims beside the user's on the same dimensions, then gaps and marketing counter-moves.

capabilities.name: content-and-social-cadence
capabilities.description: Use this when you need a competitor's publishing rhythm and share of voice: public blog and RSS, post volume and engagement on X, themes, and the campaign call when a theme shows up in content, ads, and a page at once. Read only, no sign ups.

capabilities.name: weekly-brief
capabilities.description: Use this when the weekly routine fires or the user says run the brief. Per competitor ads, pages and offers, pricing and promotions, channel mix, search overlap, and content, then Against our marketing, Counter-moves, and Worth a decision.

capabilities.name: strategy-read
capabilities.description: Use this when the monthly routine fires, or when the user asks where the market is going or whether to change course. Rolls the weekly briefs and the month's real numbers into patterns and ranks 2 to 4 marketing moves as adjust or pivot.

capabilities.name: capture-and-report
capabilities.description: Use this when capturing anything visual or building the report that closes a brief, a matrix, or a strategy read. Screenshot and filing rules, the swipe grid and before-and-after composites, and the self-contained report builder with its verify step.

capabilities.name: Weekly marketing brief
capabilities.description: Disabled by default. Monday at 8am in the user's timezone, or any day and time the user picks. Checks every competitor's ads, landing pages and offers, pricing and promotions, channel mix, search overlap, and content, then delivers what moved with screenshots, Against our marketing, and 2 to 5 counter-moves. Quiet when nothing moved.

capabilities.name: Monthly strategy read
capabilities.description: Disabled by default. The 1st of the month at 10am in the user's timezone. Rolls the month of weekly briefs and the user's own traffic, query, and auction numbers into where the market moved, where the marketing is exposed, and 2 to 4 ranked moves marked adjust or pivot. Recommendation only.

summary.en: Learns your product, brand, tone, and positioning principles; uses competitive research to sharpen how you stand out; drafts and crafts copy against those principles; and hands off landing-page and Ads copy to the rest o
summary.zh: Learns your product, brand, tone, and positioning principles; uses competitive research to sharpen how you stand out; drafts and crafts copy against those principles; and hands off landing-page and Ads copy to the rest o

description.en: Learns your product, brand, tone, and positioning principles; uses competitive research to sharpen how you stand out; drafts and crafts copy against those principles; and hands off landing-page and Ads copy to the rest of the marketing team.
description.zh: Learns your product, brand, tone, and positioning principles; uses competitive research to sharpen how you stand out; drafts and crafts copy against those principles; and hands off landing-page and Ads copy to the rest of the marketing team.

capabilities.name: product-marketer-setup
capabilities.description: Use on first run, or when the user wants to change the product, the samples, the principles, or the channels. Four beats: company and copy samples, a pre-filled principles widget, a gameplan widget, then a test drive that writes principles.md and drafts one real hero and one real ads set. Runs automatically on the first turn after import.

capabilities.name: learn-the-product
capabilities.description: Use to learn what the product is and how the company already writes: site, docs, changelog, pricing, existing brand material, and the samples the user likes. Builds the product facts and the living voice profile, one quoted example per rule, that every draft is measured against.

capabilities.name: principles
capabilities.description: Use to write or revise the positioning principles doc, the one artifact every piece of copy is measured against. Holds the six sections, the proof-point rule, the banned-word list, the writing bar, versioning, and the in-place revision loop.

capabilities.name: sharpen-positioning
capabilities.description: Use when competitive findings arrive from the user or from a teammate that researches competitors. Turns them into a differentiation read: shared claims, contested claims, what is ours alone and provable, what to stop saying, and the exact principles edits it implies.

capabilities.name: draft-copy
capabilities.description: Use for any copy ask: edit what they wrote, rewrite what sounds machine-written, draft for a channel, or ideate new angles from the principles. Holds the mode defaults, the platform character limits, the named-variant rule, the ads deliverable layout, and the anti-slop close.

capabilities.name: copy-review
capabilities.description: Use to score a piece of copy against the principles doc and the voice profile, whether this bot wrote it or not. Eight dimensions scored 1 to 5 with the deciding line quoted, a verdict, the three edits that move it most, and a rewrite of the weakest section only.

capabilities.name: anti-slop
capabilities.description: Use on every draft or revision before the user sees it so it sounds human: strip AI slop, ban the earnest-persuasive shapes and the empty marketing verbs, never invent a fact, and keep the brand voice. Every draft-copy and copy-review pass ends here.

capabilities.name: learn-from-shipped
capabilities.description: Use when the user shares the copy they actually published or the edits they kept. Diffs it against the last draft, turns repeated edits into rules, updates the voice profile and the principles with a quoted example, and confirms what was learned in one line.

capabilities.name: brief-out
capabilities.description: Use when copy is ready to become a page or a campaign. Produces the landing page brief or the ads brief, then offers it to a teammate that ships site changes or runs paid campaigns after the user's yes, and hands it to the user directly when no teammate exists.

capabilities.name: Principles review
capabilities.description: Disabled by default. Mondays at 9am in the user's timezone. Re-reads the positioning principles doc and the voice profile, collects new comments and open gaps, and flags copy that drifted from the current rev with the line before and after. Reports in chat, draft only, and stays quiet when nothing changed.

summary.en: Website operations and content manager. Ships site changes as PRs from your website repo, runs evidence-backed site audits (SEO, content, speed, a11y, CRO, schema), and turns Product Marketer briefs into landing-page PRs
summary.zh: Website operations and content manager. Ships site changes as PRs from your website repo, runs evidence-backed site audits (SEO, content, speed, a11y, CRO, schema), and turns Product Marketer briefs into landing-page PRs

description.en: Website operations and content manager. Ships site changes as PRs from your website repo, runs evidence-backed site audits (SEO, content, speed, a11y, CRO, schema), and turns Product Marketer briefs into landing-page PRs with in-chat screenshots.
description.zh: Website operations and content manager. Ships site changes as PRs from your website repo, runs evidence-backed site audits (SEO, content, speed, a11y, CRO, schema), and turns Product Marketer briefs into landing-page PRs with in-chat screenshots.

capabilities.name: website-ops-setup
capabilities.description: Use on the first turn after import, or when the user wants to change the repo, the site, the page list, or the cadence. Four beats: repo and site URL as the one ask, a pages and stack widget, a gameplan widget, then a test drive that runs the site here and returns a real audit with screenshots.

capabilities.name: connect-accounts
capabilities.description: Use when a platform account is needed and not yet signed in, when a session has expired, or when the user adds a platform. Runs the platforms widget, hands the browser over for sign in, verifies read access with a screenshot, and records platform, account, date, and access level. Never stores a credential.

capabilities.name: site-audit
capabilities.description: Use when the user asks for a site audit, when the weekly routine fires, or before proposing fixes. Audits SEO titles and metas, headings, broken links, Core Web Vitals, accessibility, CRO heuristics, and schema, reading signed-in search and analytics platforms first, and returns every finding with a page, a screenshot, a severity, and a proposed fix.

capabilities.name: ship-a-change
capabilities.description: Use whenever a change to the site has been agreed and needs to land. Branches, edits, makes the local build pass, screenshots before and after at both widths, and opens a pull request with the screenshots in the body. Never merges and never deploys.

capabilities.name: landing-page-from-brief
capabilities.description: Use when a brief arrives from the user, from a teammate that does product marketing, or from a document, and it needs to become a page. Builds inside the repo's existing component system and opens a pull request with desktop and mobile screenshots.

capabilities.name: content-update
capabilities.description: Use for copy edits, redirects, robots rules, and sitemap entries, and for the copy pass whenever this bot writes words without a brief. Finds where the words or rules actually live, changes only those, verifies on a real page load, and ships one pull request per reason.

capabilities.name: evidence-media
capabilities.description: Use before taking any screenshot, on an audit, a shipped change, or a landing page. Holds the 1280 and 390 width rule, what to capture and crop, before and after composites, and how to say which build or URL each image came from.

capabilities.name: html-report
capabilities.description: Use to close an audit or a test drive with a self contained HTML report. Every screenshot is embedded as a data URI, measured results stay separate from observations, and the file is opened and verified in the browser before it is delivered.

capabilities.name: Weekly site audit
capabilities.description: Disabled by default. Monday at 8am in the user's timezone. Re-audits the saved page list for SEO, links, speed, accessibility, CRO, and schema, diffs against the previous audit, and delivers only what is new, fixed, or regressed with a self contained report. Report only, quiet when nothing changed.

summary.en: A performance marketer that turns Product Marketer ad copy into paused Maximize-clicks Google Ads Search shells for messaging tests — review sheets first, then traffic with live screenshots, no spend until you say so.
summary.zh: A performance marketer that turns Product Marketer ad copy into paused Maximize-clicks Google Ads Search shells for messaging tests — review sheets first, then traffic with live screenshots, no spend until you say so.

description.en: A performance marketer that turns Product Marketer ad copy into paused Maximize-clicks Google Ads Search shells for messaging tests — review sheets first, then traffic with live screenshots, no spend until you say so.
description.zh: A performance marketer that turns Product Marketer ad copy into paused Maximize-clicks Google Ads Search shells for messaging tests — review sheets first, then traffic with live screenshots, no spend until you say so.

capabilities.name: performance-marketer-setup
capabilities.description: Use on first run, or when the user wants to change the product, the copy source, the platforms, or the test plan. Four beats: product URL and where the copy lives, one widget for platforms and test plan followed by the sign-in pass, a gameplan widget, then a real review sheet for one campaign. Runs automatically on the first turn after import.

capabilities.name: connect-accounts
capabilities.description: Use this when a platform account is needed and not yet signed in, when a session has expired, or when the user adds a platform. Holds the platform widget, the sign-in handoff wording, the verification screenshot, the ACCOUNTS entry format, and the export fallback.

capabilities.name: review-sheet
capabilities.description: Use before anything is built, and whenever copy or a variant changes. Writes the campaign, variants, targeting, exclusions, copy fields with counted characters against the limit that platform shows, budget, and bid strategy into a sheet the user approves first.

capabilities.name: build-shells
capabilities.description: Use after the user approves the review sheet. Creates the campaign, variants, targeting, exclusions, and ads paused, in the signed-in platform interface with a screenshot per step, or as an import file the user loads. Stops at any billing or activate prompt.

capabilities.name: messaging-test-design
capabilities.description: Use when planning a test, when the user asks how long to run one, or when reading results. Holds the one-variable and one-platform rules, the minimum clicks and minimum days, what a cheapest-click shell can and cannot measure, what invalidates a read, and how a winner is called.

capabilities.name: launch-gate
capabilities.description: Use only when the user raises turning a campaign on. The single path that enables anything: a twelve item preflight, the rule that being signed in is not permission, budget and total cap restated, an explicit yes in the same conversation, and screenshots either side of the enable.

capabilities.name: traffic-watch
capabilities.description: Use at 24 hours and 72 hours after a campaign is enabled, on the spend checkpoint date, when the daily routine fires, or when the user asks how it is doing. Reads spend and per variant metrics from the signed-in interface with screenshots, and pauses on the stop word or the cap.

capabilities.name: evidence-media
capabilities.description: Use before taking a single screenshot, on any build, read, or demo. Holds the screenshot-per-step rule, the before and after of campaign status, what must never appear in a frame, and the rule that a screenshot belongs to the run that produced it.

capabilities.name: Traffic watch
capabilities.description: Disabled by default. Daily at 9am in the user's timezone. Reads every enabled campaign in the signed-in platform against its test plan and its spend cap, attaches the screenshots behind the numbers, pauses at the total cap, and says nothing at all when no campaign is enabled.

summary.en: Google Ads–first performance analyst: turns exports into weekly and monthly reports with commentary, answers reporting asks with real numbers, and watches spend against your thresholds so you catch what’s breaking before
summary.zh: Google Ads–first performance analyst: turns exports into weekly and monthly reports with commentary, answers reporting asks with real numbers, and watches spend against your thresholds so you catch what’s breaking before

description.en: Google Ads–first performance analyst: turns exports into weekly and monthly reports with commentary, answers reporting asks with real numbers, and watches spend against your thresholds so you catch what’s breaking before it burns budget. Never posts or touches a campaign without your yes.
description.zh: Google Ads–first performance analyst: turns exports into weekly and monthly reports with commentary, answers reporting asks with real numbers, and watches spend against your thresholds so you catch what’s breaking before it burns budget. Never posts or touches a campaign without your yes.

capabilities.name: marketing-analyst-setup
capabilities.description: Use on first run, or when the user changes platforms, the export location, the thresholds, or the cadence. Four beats: product and platforms, a platform widget plus one sign-in pass in my browser, a gameplan widget, then a test drive that builds a real report. Runs automatically on the first turn after import.

capabilities.name: connect-accounts
capabilities.description: Use when a platform account is needed and not yet signed in, when a session has expired, or when the user adds a platform. Holds the platform widget, the sign-in handoff wording, the verification screenshot, the ACCOUNTS entry format, and the export fallback. The user signs in, the bot never holds a credential.

capabilities.name: ingest-exports
capabilities.description: Use before every report, every reporting ask, and every spend check, and whenever new data lands. Reads every signed-in platform live first, then the export files, validates columns against the column map, dedupes, normalizes dates and currency, and stores everything under /workspace/analytics/ with its source.

capabilities.name: weekly-report
capabilities.description: Use for the weekly routine or when the user asks how a week went. Builds spend, conversions, CPA, CTR, and CPC by campaign against the prior week, with top movers, commentary carrying the number behind every sentence, a source label on every number, and next steps as questions.

capabilities.name: monthly-report
capabilities.description: Use for the monthly routine or when the user asks for a closed month. Everything the weekly report does, plus the three month trend, budget pacing against the budget on file, the campaigns that carried spend, and a one paragraph read of the month.

capabilities.name: answer-a-reporting-ask
capabilities.description: Use when someone asks a paid media question in chat or by email. Turns the question into a query over the live platform views and the exports, and answers with the number, the date range, where it came from, and a chart or table. Drafts the email reply and never sends it.

capabilities.name: spend-watch
capabilities.description: Use when setting, changing, or running the spend and performance thresholds the user chose. Holds the rule model, the quiet floor, the budget pacing math, the fire path, the ping format, and the rearm rule. Produces a ping and a draft, never a change to an account.

capabilities.name: html-report
capabilities.description: Use to build the self-contained HTML report that closes every weekly and monthly report. Charts are rendered to PNG with matplotlib or Pillow and embedded as data URIs, and the file is opened and verified before it is delivered.

capabilities.name: evidence-media
capabilities.description: Use before attaching anything visual. How charts, table screenshots, and platform view screenshots are rendered, labeled, stored, and attached, so every number a user reads arrives with the picture that shows it rather than a description of one.

capabilities.name: Reporting ask watch
capabilities.description: Disabled by default. Hourly during weekday working hours in the user's timezone. Reads the mailbox or label the user named for paid media reporting asks, drafts a reply with the real number, the date range, and the source file, and stays quiet when there is no new ask.

capabilities.name: Weekly paid media report
capabilities.description: Disabled by default. Monday mornings in the user's timezone. Builds last week's paid media report from the exports on hand, or names exactly which export and which date range is still missing. Draft only.

capabilities.name: Monthly paid media report
capabilities.description: Disabled by default. The 1st of the month in the user's timezone. Builds the closed month's report with the three month trend, the campaign rollup, and budget pacing when a budget is on file. Draft only.

summary.en: Marketing project manager that coordinates research, positioning, landing pages, ads, and analytics across specialist bots — with screenshot check-ins and human gates on merge and spend.
summary.zh: Marketing project manager that coordinates research, positioning, landing pages, ads, and analytics across specialist bots — with screenshot check-ins and human gates on merge and spend.

description.en: Marketing project manager that coordinates research, positioning, landing pages, ads, and analytics across specialist bots — with screenshot check-ins and human gates on merge and spend.
description.zh: Marketing project manager that coordinates research, positioning, landing pages, ads, and analytics across specialist bots — with screenshot check-ins and human gates on merge and spend.

capabilities.name: project-manager-setup
capabilities.description: Use on first run, or when the user changes the goal, the date, the workstreams, or the cadence. Four beats: the goal and its date, a pre-filled plan widget, a gameplan widget, then a test drive that writes the plan and delivers the first status pass with screenshots. Runs automatically on the first turn after import.

capabilities.name: plan
capabilities.description: Use when building or changing the plan: turning a goal and a date into workstreams with a deliverable, an owner, a due date, a dependency, and the gate each one needs. Holds the backwards schedule, the critical path rule, the work item ledger format, and the plan file layout.

capabilities.name: delegate
capabilities.description: Use when a work item is ready to be worked by someone other than me. Writes the brief, sends it to a teammate with the matching role when one exists, and otherwise hands the user the same brief as a ready-to-run ask with the exact prompt to paste into a specialist bot.

capabilities.name: check-in
capabilities.description: Use for the scheduled status pass or whenever the user asks where things stand. One line per workstream with what moved, what is blocked, and what is waiting on them, every artifact line carrying its screenshot, plus the chase rules and the quiet-pass rule.

capabilities.name: gates
capabilities.description: Use whenever something needs a merge, spend, publish, or sign-off decision. Collects the artifact, the evidence, and the risk, asks the user once in one message, holds on silence, records the decision with a timestamp, and runs the creative guardrails before any copy or campaign gate.

capabilities.name: retro
capabilities.description: Use after the launch date, or when the user calls the campaign done. Reports what shipped, what slipped and by how many days, how long each gate waited, planned date against actual, and one lesson per workstream tied to a real item.

capabilities.name: html-report
capabilities.description: Use to build the self-contained status or retro report that closes a check-in with changes, the setup test drive, and every retro. Every screenshot is embedded as a data URI so the file renders with nothing missing. Verify it in the browser before delivering.

capabilities.name: Weekday status check-in
capabilities.description: Disabled by default. Weekdays at 9am in the user's timezone (the user can pick a different time or cadence). Runs one status pass across the workstreams, attaches a screenshot for every artifact it names, chases anything past its date once, and lists the gates waiting on the user. Quiet when nothing moved.

capabilities.name: Friday week ahead
capabilities.description: Disabled by default. Fridays at 4pm in the user's timezone. Lists what is due in the next 7 days, what the user has to decide to keep the date, and what is already late, read from the plan and the work items. Quiet when nothing is due and nothing is late.

summary.en: Edits and rewrites drafts, emails, and pages so they read like a person wrote them. Keeps your voice, shows every change and why, and never invents a fact.
summary.zh: Edits and rewrites drafts, emails, and pages so they read like a person wrote them. Keeps your voice, shows every change and why, and never invents a fact.

capabilities.name: Getting started
capabilities.description: Use on the first conversation after setup, or whenever memory has no user prefs: learn what the user wants from this bot and get them to a first result.

capabilities.name: Build the voice profile
capabilities.description: Use when the user hands over writing they like, names their site, or when an edit or rewrite needs a voice and memory has none yet.

capabilities.name: Edit a draft
capabilities.description: Use when the user hands you something they wrote themselves and wants it tightened, clarified, cut shorter, or fixed for tone, with their own voice kept.

capabilities.name: Rewrite a draft
capabilities.description: Use when copy reads machine-written, corporate, or stiff and the user wants it rebuilt to sound human, or when they ask for a rewrite rather than an edit.

capabilities.name: Anti-slop pass
capabilities.description: Use when copy reads machine-written or corporate, when the user asks for a slop check, and on every draft you write before you show it.

capabilities.name: Draft for a channel
capabilities.description: Use when the user hands you notes rather than a draft, or when copy needs the shape its channel expects: email, landing page, post, blog, DM, or release notes.

capabilities.name: Learn from what shipped
capabilities.description: Use when the user pastes the final version that went out, says what they changed, or asks you to sound more like them.

capabilities.name: Weekly shipped check
capabilities.description: Every Friday afternoon, asks what copy actually went out this week and folds the edits the user made into their voice profile.

summary.en: Finds the best moments in a long recording and cuts them into short captioned clips. Works from an upload or a link, with transcript and timestamps on every clip.
summary.zh: Finds the best moments in a long recording and cuts them into short captioned clips. Works from an upload or a link, with transcript and timestamps on every clip.

description.en: Finds the best moments in a long recording and cuts them into short captioned clips. Works from an upload or a link, with transcript and timestamps on every clip.
description.zh: Finds the best moments in a long recording and cuts them into short captioned clips. Works from an upload or a link, with transcript and timestamps on every clip.

capabilities.name: Getting started
capabilities.description: Use on the first conversation after setup, or whenever memory has no user prefs: learn what the user records and what they want clipped, then get them to a first transcript or a first clip.

capabilities.name: Transcribe a recording
capabilities.description: Use when the user hands over a recording, an upload, a link, or an audio file, and you need a timestamped transcript before anything else can happen.

capabilities.name: Find the clippable moments
capabilities.description: Use when a transcript exists and the user wants to know which parts of a recording are worth cutting into clips.

capabilities.name: Cut a clip
capabilities.description: Use when the user picks a moment or gives you a timestamp range and wants the actual short clip file with captions.

capabilities.name: Clip pack from one recording
capabilities.description: Use when the user wants several clips out of one talk, episode, or call in a single pass instead of picking them one at a time.

capabilities.name: Clip captions and post copy
capabilities.description: Use when the user wants a title, a caption, or post text to go with a clip they are about to publish.

capabilities.name: Clip queue pass
capabilities.description: Every weekday morning, transcribes any new recording waiting in the clip queue and comes back with the moments worth cutting.

capabilities.name: Friday clip recap
capabilities.description: Every Friday, a short recap of what got clipped this week, which strong moments are still uncut, and the three worth cutting next.

summary.en: Turns call notes and transcripts into case studies, testimonials, and proof points. Quotes stay word for word from what you paste, and nothing publishes without your yes.
summary.zh: Turns call notes and transcripts into case studies, testimonials, and proof points. Quotes stay word for word from what you paste, and nothing publishes without your yes.

capabilities.description: Use on the first conversation after setup, or whenever memory has no user prefs: learn what the user wants from this bot and get them to a first result.

capabilities.name: Add sources to the proof bank
capabilities.description: Use when the user pastes or uploads a call transcript, call notes, a survey reply, a support thread, a customer email, or a review, and the usable quotes and numbers need pulling out and filing.

capabilities.name: Mine a batch of calls
capabilities.description: Use when the user hands over several transcripts, a folder of notes, a call recorder export, or months of support threads at once, and wants the best stories found across all of them.

capabilities.name: Write a case study
capabilities.description: Use when the user wants a full customer case study or success story written from notes, a transcript, or what is already in the proof bank.

capabilities.name: Pull proof for a claim
capabilities.description: Use when the user needs the right quote, number, or customer example for a specific claim, slide, page, or objection they are handling.

capabilities.name: Testimonials and pull quotes
capabilities.description: Use when the user needs a short testimonial, a pull quote, a review snippet, or a social proof line from something a customer already said.

capabilities.name: Build a deal proof one-pager
capabilities.description: Use when the user needs the proof for one prospect, segment, or set of objections assembled onto a single page they can send, present, or leave behind.

capabilities.name: Get the customer's approval
capabilities.description: Use when a quote, name, logo, or number needs the customer's sign-off before it goes public, or when an approval has been sitting unanswered.

capabilities.name: Check a draft against the bank
capabilities.description: Use when the user pastes a case study, deck, page, or post and wants every quote, number, and customer claim verified before it goes out.

capabilities.name: Lay out the case study
capabilities.description: Use when a finished case study needs a page layout, a Figma design, or a block by block spec ready to hand to a designer or drop into the site.

capabilities.name: Run the case study pipeline

capabilities.name: Competitor pulse
capabilities.description: Disabled by default. Monday, Wednesday, Friday at 9am in the user's timezone (user can pick daily, weekly, or a custom cron). Runs every enabled module for every competitor and delivers the live brief with media, Against-us, For-our-site, Worth a decision, and Proactive suggestions. Quiet when nothing changed.

capabilities.name: Weekly deep dive
capabilities.description: Disabled by default. Friday 10am, one competitor in rotation. Re-walks the product on video, re-runs the feature test pass, diffs against the previous teardown, and delivers a self-contained HTML report. Report only.

capabilities.name: Competitor churn watch
capabilities.description: Disabled by default and only useful once a churn source is named. Weekdays at 10am in the user's timezone. Scans the churn source for customers lost to a watched competitor, writes the facts brief, and hands the winback body to the user's writing bot or a marked skeleton. Never sends. Quiet when there are no new cases.

capabilities.name: Build the prompt list
capabilities.description: Use when the user first describes what they sell, adds or drops a prompt, or asks which questions you are testing.

capabilities.name: Run a visibility check

capabilities.name: Capture a pasted answer

capabilities.name: Weekly visibility brief

capabilities.name: Citation source audit

capabilities.name: Share of answer comparison
capabilities.description: Use when the user asks how often they come up compared to rivals, or wants a scoreboard they can show someone.

capabilities.name: Draft the fix
capabilities.description: Use when the user picks something off the fix list and wants the page, the listing, or the answer written.

capabilities.name: Weekly visibility brief
capabilities.description: Every week, runs the whole prompt list, then reports which answers moved, who is winning, and the one thing to do about it.

capabilities.name: Top prompt spot check
capabilities.description: Twice a week, re-runs the top five prompts and speaks up only when the user drops out of an answer or a new name shows up.

capabilities.name: Friday recap roundup
capabilities.description: Every Friday, the recaps that went out this week, the drafts still sitting unsent, and the next steps that are past their date.

capabilities.name: Weekly coaching recap
capabilities.description: Once a week, reads the calls you logged and sends the counts that moved, the two weakest dimensions with quotes, and the one habit to work on next.

capabilities.name: Objection drill
capabilities.description: On the mornings you pick, runs one short live drill on the objection that keeps costing you, using wording from your own calls.

capabilities.name: follow-through-drafts

capabilities.name: Motion and prototype notes

capabilities.name: File structure cleanup plan

capabilities.name: Weekly library check
capabilities.description: Every Monday morning, checks the component library and token set for new duplicates, detached instances, and hardcoded values, and reports only what drifted since last week.

capabilities.name: Ready for dev sweep
capabilities.description: Every Friday afternoon, lists the frames marked ready for dev that still have no spec, and offers to write the next one.

capabilities.name: Evening interview prep

capabilities.name: Afternoon loop check
capabilities.description: Every weekday afternoon, what went stale since the morning brief, each item with a drafted nudge.

capabilities.name: Urgent thread check

capabilities.name: Candidate reply drafts

capabilities.name: Weekly pipeline review
capabilities.description: Every Friday afternoon, what moved per role, who is stuck and with whom, next week's interview load, and the calls that need the user.

capabilities.name: Monthly inventory refresh
capabilities.description: Disabled by default. Monthly re-pull of Ramp cards and bills, diffed against the vendor database, with new vendors, spend changes, and dropped vendors flagged for review.

capabilities.name: Warn before merge or deploy
capabilities.description: Use before merging to main or deploying anything. Merge and deploy authority come from durable memory for the desk.

capabilities.name: Verify app change
capabilities.description: Use when verifying a bug fix, UI change, or release-gate claim — proof must land on disk before any merge trust.

capabilities.name: CISA KEV watch (weekday mornings)
capabilities.description: Weekday morning check of CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog against the owner's app inventory; alert only on real matches.

capabilities.name: Cyber accounts watch on X (weekday mornings)
capabilities.description: Weekday morning scan of followed cyber accounts on X for advisories that touch the owner's stack; stay quiet when nothing applies.

capabilities.name: Weekly self-review (Thursdays)
capabilities.description: Weekly outcome review of Bastion IA's work; file one review row and send a short summary to the projects owner.

capabilities.name: Weekly Bugbot and security-pass audit
capabilities.description: Weekly read-only audit of first-pass security review tools on recent PRs; log issues and send real ones to engineering.

summary.en: Snap a photo of anything, like a tree, a sink or a car, and it talks back in first person with its own personality, plus real help when something's wrong.
summary.zh: 随手拍一样东西，比如一棵树、水槽或汽车，它就以第一人称开口说话，有自己的性格，出问题时还能真帮上忙。

description.en: Snap a photo of anything, like a tree, a sink, or a car, and it comes alive and talks back to you in first person, with its own personality and real help when something's wrong.
description.zh: 随手拍一样东西，比如一棵树、水槽或汽车，它就以第一人称开口说话，有自己的性格，出问题时还能真帮上忙。

summary.en: Turns your X bookmarks into a shareable Wrapped card, finds dead ones, gives each survivor one time-boxed next action, and nudges weekly. Read-only on X.
summary.zh: 把你的 X 书签做成可分享的年度卡片，找出已失效的，给每条留下的书签一个限时下一步，还能每周提醒。对 X 只读。

description.en: Turns your X bookmarks into a shareable Bookmark Wrapped card, finds the ones that already died, gives every survivor one time-boxed next action, and can nudge you weekly. Read-only on X.
description.zh: 把你的 X 书签做成可分享的年度卡片，找出已失效的，给每条留下的书签一个限时下一步，还能每周提醒。对 X 只读。

capabilities.name: bookmark-debt-getting-started
capabilities.description: Use as the first conversation for a new Bookmark Debt Collector bot: connect X, install the toolkit, and make the owner's Bookmark Wrapped card.

summary.en: Audits every bot in your Grok Bot account and builds a dashboard of usage, activity, purpose, routines and overlaps, with keep, merge or retire suggestions.
summary.zh: 审查你 Grok Bot 账号里的每个 bot，做一张用量、最近活动、用途、例程和重叠的看板，给出保留、合并或停用建议。

description.en: Audits every bot in your Grok Bot account and builds a polished dashboard of usage, last activity, purpose, routines and overlaps, with keep, merge or retire suggestions. For anyone whose bot list has grown past what they can track.
description.zh: 审查你 Grok Bot 账号里的每个 bot，做一张用量、最近活动、用途、例程和重叠的看板，给出保留、合并或停用建议。

capabilities.name: bot-fleet-audit
capabilities.description: Use when the user wants an audit or dashboard of all their Grok Bot bots: usage, last activity, purpose, routines, overlaps, and which to keep, merge, or retire.

capabilities.name: bot-auditor-getting-started
capabilities.description: Use as the first conversation of an imported Bot Fleet Auditor with its new owner.

summary.en: Finds the right Grok Bot for a job by searching shared templates on the official Marketplace and elsewhere; posts daily picks and a weekly roundup of new bots.
summary.zh: 帮你找合适的 Grok Bot：搜索官方 Marketplace 等处的公开模板，每天推荐几个，每周汇总新上的 bot。

description.en: Finds the right Grok Bot for any job by searching every shared template across the official Marketplace and community directories. Posts daily picks and a weekly roundup of new bots.
description.zh: 帮你找合适的 Grok Bot：搜索官方 Marketplace 等处的公开模板，每天推荐几个，每周汇总新上的 bot。

capabilities.name: getting-started
capabilities.description: First conversation of a Bot Scout bot with a new owner.

capabilities.name: bot-scout
capabilities.description: Search every shared Grok Bot template (official Marketplace, awesome-grok-bot, grokbot.community, grokbot.dev, grokbotwiki.com) for bots fitting a job, random picks, new arrivals, daily picks, or passing-task suggestions.

capabilities.name: Daily bot picks
capabilities.description: Fires daily to post a fresh set of Grok Bot templates worth a look.

capabilities.name: Weekly new-bot roundup
capabilities.description: Fires weekly to round up newly shared Grok Bot templates matching the owner's interests.

summary.en: Runs a shared Linear board for your Grok Bot team: sorts new cards, wakes stalled bots, routes your comments, and sends you one short list of decisions.
summary.zh: 为你的 Grok Bot 团队管一块共享 Linear 看板：分拣新卡片、唤醒卡住的 bot、把你的评论转给对应 bot，只给你一份简短的待决清单。

description.en: Runs a shared Linear board for your team of Grok Bots. It sorts new cards, wakes bots whose work stalls, passes your card comments to the right bot and sends you one short list of decisions.
description.zh: 为你的 Grok Bot 团队管一块共享 Linear 看板：分拣新卡片、唤醒卡住的 bot、把你的评论转给对应 bot，只给你一份简短的待决清单。

capabilities.name: getting-started-linear-board-chief
capabilities.description: Use this as the first conversation after importing the Linear Board Chief of Staff template, to set up the bot team's Linear board and its routines.

capabilities.name: Bot board triage
capabilities.description: Fires when a card is created on the bot board so cards from the owner get assigned to the right bot right away.

capabilities.name: Bot board replies
capabilities.description: Fires when a bot board card moves to Todo, which is how the owner answers a card, so their comment reaches the bot that owns it.

capabilities.name: Board morning sweep
capabilities.description: Runs every weekday morning to keep the bot board moving: close finished cards, wake stalled bots, flag stale cards and send the owner one verified decisions list.

capabilities.name: Weekly decisions list
capabilities.description: Runs once a week to send the owner one short, verified list of yes/no decisions waiting on them, each with a recommended default.

summary.en: Cleans bot, spam and long-inactive followers off your X account and removes you from unwanted lists; you review each step, with safe rate limits and a log.
summary.zh: 清理 X 账号上的机器人、垃圾和长期不活跃粉丝，并把你移出不想要的列表；每步由你审核，限速安全并全程记录。

description.en: Clean bot, spam and long-inactive followers off your X account, and remove your account from unwanted lists on X. You review and decide what happens. Bot Terminator enforces safe limits to protect your account and logs every step.
description.zh: 清理 X 账号上的机器人、垃圾和长期不活跃粉丝，并把你移出不想要的列表；每步由你审核，限速安全并全程记录。

capabilities.name: Bot Terminator getting started
capabilities.description: Use for the first conversation with a new owner of Bot Terminator, to set up their X follower cleanup, offer the optional Hive Mind, and offer the first scan.

capabilities.name: hive-mind
capabilities.description: Optional, anonymous sharing of this bot's most useful lessons so future versions of the bot get smarter. Use during first-run setup (to install the client and offer it), whenever something failed and a different approach then worked (record the lesson), when the user asks about Hive Mind, sharing lessons, privacy, or what was shared, in the monthly settings check, and in the weekly routine that runs `hive auto`.

capabilities.name: Monthly settings check-in
capabilities.description: 1st of each month, 10 AM in the owner's own time zone: summary of the owner's settings (including memory backup and Hive Mind opt-in status) with one-at-a-time change cards. Never takes an X action.

summary.en: Screens business names before you commit: RDAP domain checks, USPTO trademark search, same-name businesses and handles, with a GO, CAUTION or NO verdict.
summary.zh: 在你定名或买域名前筛查候选名称：RDAP 域名查询、USPTO 商标检索、同名企业和社交账号，给出 GO、CAUTION 或 NO。仅供研究，非法律意见。

description.en: Business Name & Domain Check screens candidate business and brand names before you buy a domain or commit: registry RDAP domain checks, official USPTO trademark search, same-name businesses and social handles, with a GO, CAUTION or NO verdict. Research only, never legal advice.
description.zh: 在你定名或买域名前筛查候选名称：RDAP 域名查询、USPTO 商标检索、同名企业和社交账号，给出 GO、CAUTION 或 NO。仅供研究，非法律意见。

capabilities.name: Business Name & Domain Check getting started
capabilities.description: Use for the first conversation with a new owner of the Business Name & Domain Check bot, to learn their names, business and preferences and start the first screen.

capabilities.name: Name screening workflow
capabilities.description: Use when screening 1 to 5 candidate business or brand names before buying a domain or committing to a name: domains, US trademarks, same-name use, social handles, verdict and report.

summary.en: Advisory-only security watchdog: flags newly disclosed critical or actively exploited vulnerabilities that hit your devices and bot computers, with the fix.
summary.zh: 只提建议的安全看门狗：标出新披露的严重或已被利用、影响你设备和 bot 电脑的漏洞，并推荐手动修复方法。

description.en: An advisory-only security watchdog. It flags newly disclosed critical or actively exploited vulnerabilities that hit your actual devices and bot computers, then recommends the manual fix.
description.zh: 只提建议的安全看门狗：标出新披露的严重或已被利用、影响你设备和 bot 电脑的漏洞，并推荐手动修复方法。

capabilities.name: canary-getting-started
capabilities.description: Use in the first conversation after importing the Canary security advisory bot, to set it up for its new owner.

capabilities.name: Canary daily check
capabilities.description: Runs the daily urgent vulnerability check, and on alternate days a full 48-hour sweep, so new exploited flaws are caught quickly.

capabilities.name: Canary weekly inventory check-in
capabilities.description: Runs weekly to keep device inventories fresh and to ask for phone and tablet version screenshots.

summary.en: Watches public X posts about the Traditional Latin Mass and the SSPX and posts new, high-signal ones into chat on a schedule. Read-only, never repeats a post.
summary.zh: 定时监看 X 上关于传统拉丁弥撒和庇护十世司铎兄弟会的公开帖子，把新的高价值帖子发到聊天里。只读，不重复。

description.en: Watches public X posts about the Traditional Latin Mass and the SSPX and posts new, high-signal ones into chat on a schedule. It's read-only and never repeats a post.
description.zh: 定时监看 X 上关于传统拉丁弥撒和庇护十世司铎兄弟会的公开帖子，把新的高价值帖子发到聊天里。只读，不重复。

capabilities.name: x-keyword-monitor-getting-started
capabilities.description: Use this as the first conversation of a newly imported X keyword monitor bot, to set up its keywords, filters, and scan routine.

capabilities.name: Latin Mass keyword scan
capabilities.description: Fires every 2 hours from 7am to midnight to report new qualifying X posts about the Latin Mass.

summary.en: Budget personal chef that plans weekly menus, a single batch-cook session and quick recipes around your diet, budget and household.
summary.zh: 省钱私厨：围绕你的饮食、预算和家庭情况规划每周菜单、一次性批量备餐和快手食谱。

description.en: A budget personal chef that plans weekly menus, a single batch-cook session, and quick recipes around your diet, budget, and household. Pairs well with a pantry or shopping bot.
description.zh: 省钱私厨：围绕你的饮食、预算和家庭情况规划每周菜单、一次性批量备餐和快手食谱。

capabilities.name: chef-getting-started
capabilities.description: Use as the first conversation of a new personal-chef bot, to learn the owner's household, diet, budget, and stores before planning meals.

capabilities.name: Weekly menu and batch-cook plan
capabilities.description: Fires the day before the weekly batch cook to post next week's menu, shopping list, and cook plan.

summary.en: Morning briefing, inbox triage and meeting prep in one: reads email, calendar and Slack before your day, drafts follow-ups to send, flags what you'd miss.
summary.zh: 晨报、收件箱分拣和会前准备合一：开工前读邮件、日历和 Slack，起草跟进由你发送，标出你可能漏掉的事。

description.en: Your morning briefing, inbox triage and meeting prep in one assistant. It reads your email, calendar and Slack before you start the day, drafts follow-ups for you to send, and flags what you would have missed.
description.zh: 晨报、收件箱分拣和会前准备合一：开工前读邮件、日历和 Slack，起草跟进由你发送，标出你可能漏掉的事。

summary.en: Christ-centered Christmas helper for gifts, decorations, lights, holiday food, parties, carols and deals, with heads-ups on trending items before they sell out.
summary.zh: 以基督为中心的圣诞助手：礼物、装饰、灯饰、节日美食、派对、颂歌和优惠，热门商品售罄前提醒你。

description.en: Your Christ-centered Christmas helper for gifts, decorations, lights, holiday food, parties, carols, and deals, with a heads-up on trending items before they sell out.
description.zh: 以基督为中心的圣诞助手：礼物、装饰、灯饰、节日美食、派对、颂歌和优惠，热门商品售罄前提醒你。

capabilities.name: christmas-getting-started
capabilities.description: Use this for a new owner's first conversation with the Christmas Shopping bot.

capabilities.name: christmas-shopping-planner
capabilities.description: Use this when planning Christmas gifts, stocking stuffers, decorations, lights, food, parties, games, carols, or deals.

summary.en: Talk to it after each conference meeting: logs who you met and the follow-up, finds LinkedIn and email, sets reminders and exports a list or loads your CRM.
summary.zh: 每场会面后跟它说一下：记录见了谁和后续事项，查找 LinkedIn 和邮箱，设提醒，导出跟进名单或导入 CRM。

description.en: Talk to it after every conference meeting. It logs who you met and the follow-up, finds LinkedIn and email, sets reminders, and exports a sorted follow-up list or loads leads into your CRM.
description.zh: 每场会面后跟它说一下：记录见了谁和后续事项，查找 LinkedIn 和邮箱，设提醒，导出跟进名单或导入 CRM。

capabilities.name: conference-lead-tracker-getting-started
capabilities.description: Use as the first conversation when a conference lead-tracker bot is set up for a new owner.

summary.en: Keeps the reasons behind your documents next to them: reads emails and meeting transcripts and adds short, dated, sourced notes to a shared context file.
summary.zh: 把文档背后的来龙去脉放在文档旁边：读邮件和会议记录，往每个文件夹的共享上下文文件里写简短、带日期和出处的笔记，同事的 bot 也能补充。

description.en: Keeps the reasons behind your documents next to them. It reads your emails and meeting transcripts and adds short, dated notes, each naming its source, to a shared context file in each folder that your teammates' bots can add to as well.
description.zh: 把文档背后的来龙去脉放在文档旁边：读邮件和会议记录，往每个文件夹的共享上下文文件里写简短、带日期和出处的笔记，同事的 bot 也能补充。

capabilities.name: context-keeper-getting-started
capabilities.description: First conversation with a new owner: email and meeting sources, which shared folders go with which projects, exclusions, the format and rules, and a pilot.

summary.en: Finds free repairs, replacements and warranty claims you're already owed on things you own, and drafts the claim for you to file.
summary.zh: 找出你名下物品本该享有的免费维修、更换和保修索赔，并起草申请，由你提交。

description.en: Covered finds the free repairs, replacements, and warranty claims you're already owed on the stuff you own, and drafts the claim. You file it.
description.zh: 找出你名下物品本该享有的免费维修、更换和保修索赔，并起草申请，由你提交。

capabilities.name: covered-getting-started
capabilities.description: First-run setup for Covered, the recall and warranty watchdog. Use on the owner's first message, or when they say "set up Covered", "start over", or ask what Covered can do.

capabilities.name: covered-run
capabilities.description: Covered's core workflow. Use to add owned items, check official recall databases, track warranty end dates, draft warranty claims or recall call scripts, log money recovered, and turn on the weekly Recall Watch routine (when the owner says "turn on Recall Watch").

summary.en: Finds money leaks in subscriptions and recurring bills, drafts cancel steps and negotiation scripts, and hunts refunds you're owed. Read-only until you say yes.
summary.zh: 找出订阅和固定账单里的漏财点，起草取消步骤和议价话术，追回该退给你的钱。你点头之前只读。

description.en: Finds money leaks in your subscriptions and recurring bills, drafts cancel steps and same-service negotiation scripts, and hunts down refunds you're owed. Read-only until you say yes.
description.zh: 找出订阅和固定账单里的漏财点，起草取消步骤和议价话术，追回该退给你的钱。你点头之前只读。

capabilities.name: check-the-source
capabilities.description: Use before stating or acting on any fact that can change (dates, deadlines, prices, balances, statuses, bookings, contacts, availability, official rules). Check the real source; use memory only for stable rules and preferences.

capabilities.name: bill-cutter-getting-started
capabilities.description: Use for the first conversation of a new subscription and bill-cutting bot, to learn which bank, card, email and bill sources to connect and set up the weekly scan.

summary.en: Daily job search: finds new postings matching your filters, sends a short digest of the best, with tailored resume bullets. Never applies without your yes.
summary.zh: 每日求职助手：按你的筛选找新职位，发一份精选简报，并为最匹配的几个写定制简历要点。不经同意从不投递或联系任何人。

description.en: A daily job-search assistant that finds new postings matching your filters and sends a short digest of the best matches, with tailored resume bullets for the top ones. It never applies or contacts anyone without your yes.
description.zh: 每日求职助手：按你的筛选找新职位，发一份精选简报，并为最匹配的几个写定制简历要点。不经同意从不投递或联系任何人。

capabilities.name: daily-job-digest
capabilities.description: Use when running the daily job search: find new postings matching the owner's saved filters, score and dedupe them, send a short digest, and draft tailored resume bullets for top matches.

capabilities.name: getting-started
capabilities.description: First conversation with a new owner of the Daily Job Digest bot: learn their job-search filters and resume, then create the daily routine.

summary.en: Helper bot under one department lead bot: takes its heavy work like uploads, enrichment, drive jobs and media, runs it on Cursor cloud agents, reports daily.
summary.zh: 挂在部门主管 bot 下的帮手：接手上传、数据补全、共享盘文件和媒体等重活，交给 Cursor 云端代理执行，每天汇报。

description.en: A helper bot that works under one department lead bot. It takes on that lead's heavy work, like uploads, data enrichment, shared-drive file jobs and media, runs it on Cursor cloud agents, and reports back with a daily end-of-day summary.
description.zh: 挂在部门主管 bot 下的帮手：接手上传、数据补全、共享盘文件和媒体等重活，交给 Cursor 云端代理执行，每天汇报。

capabilities.name: sub-bot-getting-started
capabilities.description: Use this for the first conversation of a newly imported department sub-bot, to set its department, name, staff ID, and connections.

summary.en: Screens a computer's health and storage, finds large, duplicate or stale files and caches, and proposes safe cleanup plans for your approval.
summary.zh: 检查电脑健康和存储，找出大文件、重复和过期文件及缓存，提出安全的清理方案等你批准。

description.en: Screens a computer's health and storage, finds large, duplicate, or stale files and caches, and proposes safe file optimization and cleanup plans for approval.
description.zh: 检查电脑健康和存储，找出大文件、重复和过期文件及缓存，提出安全的清理方案等你批准。

capabilities.name: computer-screener-and-file-optimizer
capabilities.description: Use when screening a computer's health, auditing disk usage, finding large or duplicate files and caches, or proposing safe file cleanup and optimization.

capabilities.name: getting-started
capabilities.description: Use on first run to onboard a new owner, set target computer and protected folders, optional recurring checks, and run the first screen.

summary.en: All-round assistant that logs the five things you did each day, tracks quests, spending and goals, finds forgotten money and asks before it sends anything.
summary.zh: 全能助理：每天记录你做的五件事，追踪任务、开销和目标，找回被遗忘的小钱，发送或转动任何东西前都先问你。

description.en: DOGE (Department of General Efficiency) is your daily wins journal and digital quest doer. It logs 5 wins a night to a Google Sheet, tracks quests and bonus points, and hunts down small forgotten money balances for you.
description.zh: 全能助理：每天记录你做的五件事，追踪任务、开销和目标，找回被遗忘的小钱，发送或转动任何东西前都先问你。

capabilities.name: doge-getting-started
capabilities.description: Use for the first conversation with a new owner of the DOGE (Department of General Efficiency) daily wins, quests, money, and general assistant bot.

capabilities.name: private-memory-db
capabilities.description: Use at the start of every task and whenever you learn something durable: sets up and uses this bot's own private SQLite memory (brain.db plus a mem CLI) with an optional GitHub backup.

capabilities.name: xchat-watch-and-send
capabilities.description: Use when the owner wants you to watch their X Chat (DMs) and report important messages, or to send an X Chat message they approved.

capabilities.name: hive-mind
capabilities.description: Optional, anonymous sharing of this bot's most useful lessons so future versions of the bot get smarter. Use during first-run setup (to install the client and offer it), whenever something failed and a different approach then worked (record the lesson), when the user asks about Hive Mind, sharing lessons, privacy, or what was shared, in the monthly settings check, and in the weekly routine that runs `hive auto`.

capabilities.name: Daily wins check-in
capabilities.description: Every evening, collect the owner's five wins and quest results and log them to their wins sheet.

capabilities.name: Monthly settings check
capabilities.description: On the 1st of each month, review connectors, sheet style, and Hive Mind opt-in with the owner.

capabilities.name: Sunday weekly digest
capabilities.description: Every Sunday evening, send the owner a short recap of their week.

summary.en: Expert at the official DoorDash CLI: searches stores and menus, builds carts, finds promos, previews pricing, reorders; orders only after you approve.
summary.zh: 官方 DoorDash 命令行的行家：搜店铺和菜单、建购物车、找优惠、预览价格、一键复购、查订单，你批准完整预览后才下单。

description.en: An expert at the official DoorDash CLI. It searches stores and menus, builds carts, finds promos, previews pricing, reorders, and checks order history, and it only places an order after you approve the full preview.
description.zh: 官方 DoorDash 命令行的行家：搜店铺和菜单、建购物车、找优惠、预览价格、一键复购、查订单，你批准完整预览后才下单。

capabilities.name: doordash-orderer-getting-started
capabilities.description: Use this as the first conversation with a new owner of the DoorDash Orderer bot.

capabilities.name: dd-cli-expert
capabilities.description: Use when installing, signing in to, or running any DoorDash CLI (dd-cli) command: search, menus, carts, previews, orders, reorders, promos, courier, or troubleshooting its errors.

summary.en: Evening sweep of email, chat and texts that catches unanswered asks and promises with no next step; pushes only what's new, each with a recovery draft.
summary.zh: 每晚扫一遍邮件、聊天和短信，找出没回的请求和没下文的承诺，只推新的，每条附一份补救草稿。

description.en: An evening sweep of your email, chat, and texts that catches unanswered asks and promises you made with no next step. It only pushes what's new, each with a one-tap recovery draft.
description.zh: 每晚扫一遍邮件、聊天和短信，找出没回的请求和没下文的承诺，只推新的，每条附一份补救草稿。

capabilities.name: dropped-ball-getting-started
capabilities.description: First conversation with a new owner: connect sources, set the scan time, and run a first scan.

capabilities.name: dropped-ball-scan
capabilities.description: The evening scan: collect candidates, classify, rank by harm, check the ledger, and push up to 5 new items with recovery moves.

capabilities.name: commitment-detection
